question: Evaluate: (0.04³ + 0.02³) ÷ (0.2³ + 0.1³)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe the multiplicative relation between the numerator and denominator: 0.04 = 0.2 × 0.2 and 0.02 = 0.2 × 0.1

⇒ Numerator = (0.2 × 0.2)³ + (0.2 × 0.1)³ = 0.2³ × (0.2³ + 0.1³)

The term (0.2³ + 0.1³) is common in both the numerator and denominator and cancels out.

⇒ Result = 0.2³ = 0.008

**∴ The correct answer is 0.008.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(0.04³ + 0.02³) ÷ (0.2³ + 0.1³)

**Calculations:**

Evaluate the cubes of the given decimals directly:

⇒ 0.04³ = 0.04 × 0.04 × 0.04 = 0.000064

⇒ 0.02³ = 0.02 × 0.02 × 0.02 = 0.000008

⇒ Numerator sum = 0.000064 + 0.000008 = 0.000072

Now evaluate the denominator:

⇒ 0.2³ = 0.2 × 0.2 × 0.2 = 0.008

⇒ 0.1³ = 0.1 × 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.001

⇒ Denominator sum = 0.008 + 0.001 = 0.009

Divide the numerator sum by the denominator sum:

⇒ 0.000072 ÷ 0.009

Multiply both numerator and denominator by 1000000 to remove decimals:

⇒ 72 ÷ 9000

⇒ 8 ÷ 1000 = 0.008

**∴ The correct answer is 0.008.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Laws of Exponents

When factors are multiplied and raised to a power, the power distributes to each factor: (a × b)ⁿ = aⁿ × bⁿ.

Sum of Cubes Formula

The sum of two cubes can be factorised using the algebraic identity: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²).

Decimal Multiplication Rules

When multiplying decimals, the result has a number of decimal places equal to the sum of the decimal places in the individual numbers being multiplied.
